entries.comment: The supply of bakery products, such as cakes, certain biscuits, bagels and croissants, (being flour or egg based) is liable to VAT at the reduced rate  . This applies when the products are served with meals or supplied as a cold take-away. The supply of bread that meets the ingredient definition in Irish VAT legislation is liable to the zero rate. Food Supplement Products are also subject to the reduced rate.
